requirements.name: An operator can list and replay every dead-letter-queue message

scenarios.name: A DLQ message appears and can be replayed

tests.test: starts a replay of all DLQ messages from the admin UI
tests.notes: seeds a message, asserts it is listed, replays all, asserts 'Replay-all started' banner; the scenario's THENs ask only that the message is listed and the banner confirms the replay started, so full holds

tests.test: Should list the first 20 messages and render the table
tests.notes: lists messages; does not exercise replay

tests.test: Should start a replay-all and redirect with a success banner
Should show a banner after a %s redirect

requirements.name: An operator can delete every dead-letter-queue message, after confirming

scenarios.name: Deleting all DLQ messages requires confirmation

tests.test: starts a delete of all DLQ messages from the admin UI
tests.notes: asserts confirmation dialog, confirms, asserts 'Delete-all started' banner; the scenario's THENs ask only for the dialog and a banner confirming the deletion started, so full holds

tests.test: Should start a delete-all and redirect with a success banner
tests.notes: server action and redirect only; confirmation dialog is client-side and covered by the E2E test

tests.test: Should show a banner after a %s redirect
